title: Yinhawangka language - Wikipedia
text: Yinhawangka (Inawangga) is a Pama–Nyungan language of Western Australia. Dench (1995) believed there was insufficient data to enable it to be confidently classified, but Bowern & Koch (2004) include it among the Ngayarda languages without proviso.

title: Inawongga - Wikipedia
text: The Yinhawangka are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Inawongga, in Norman Tindale 's estimation, has about 3,600 square miles (9,300 km2) of tribal territory, living in the area around the Hardey River and as far south as Rocklea.
